packageRules.description: GHA actions: pin by SHA, tag comment auto-updated (pinGitHubActionDigests), grouped.
Base-image digest in the FROM of both Dockerfiles — keep the pinned sha256 current (ubuntu:24.04 minor patches).
The image IS ubuntu-24.04 by design — a new Ubuntu major is a new image, not a bump. Digest/patch updates of 24.04 stay enabled.

mdformat major is plugin-blocked: mdformat-tables still requires mdformat<0.8, and Renovate does not manage additional_dependencies — bump the hook and its plugins together manually once they support 1.x.
Rust tracks the official runner image (parity contract), not upstream releases — no auto-PRs; approve from the Dependency Dashboard once actions/runner-images ships the new toolchain.
Baked Python/Go toolcache minors stay patch-current only; adding/dropping a minor is a deliberate Dockerfile change (new ARG + SHA256), not a Renovate bump.

customManagers.description: ARG RUNNER_VERSION in both Dockerfiles → actions/runner releases (github-releases). NOTE: this manager does NOT bump RUNNER_SHA256 — re-verify the hash manually after a version bump.
ARG NPM_VERSION in ubuntu-24.04/Dockerfile → the npm package (npm datasource).
ARG NODE_MAJOR in ubuntu-24.04/Dockerfile → node major only (extractVersion strips minor.patch; allowedVersions in packageRules keeps it on even/LTS majors).

ARG PYTHON_3xx (toolcache) → actions/python-versions releases (tag <version>-<build>; extractVersion strips the build id and skips pre-releases). Does NOT bump PYTHON_3xx_SHA256 — recompute manually on bump.
ARG GO_1xx (toolcache) → Go releases. Does NOT bump GO_1xx_SHA256 — recompute manually from go.dev/dl JSON on bump.
ARG RUST_VERSION → rust-lang/rust releases. No hash recompute needed (RUSTUP_SHA256 is keyed by RUSTUP_VERSION, not the toolchain).
ARG RUSTUP_VERSION → rust-lang/rustup tags (no GitHub releases upstream). Does NOT bump RUSTUP_SHA256 — recompute from <url>.sha256 on bump.
Pinned tool images (dockle, dive) inside workflow run: blocks.
